children: News Corp disclosed ongoing share repurchases under a US$1 billion authorised 2025 repurchase program and reported ~US$468.5m of purchases completed to date.
Announced daily ASX notifications for its 2025 Repurchase Program authorising up to US$1 billion of Class A and B stock.
Daily buy-back filings for 9 Sep 2026 show 11,727,932 shares bought and US$304,671,186.67 paid (Class A entry).
Separate 9 Sep 2026 entry shows 5,473,560 Class B shares bought for US$161,220,182 on a prior day notification.
To date the company has purchased approximately US$468,463,939 of Class A and B shares under the 2025 Repurchase Program.
